Sec. 2 (2e-4 within +-2 sigma of NR median; 0.0106 panel), Sec. 6 item 6 (post-April-2024 projection question)

three-hypothesis framework (pi_DM = 0.01, pi_U = 0.1, L_U = 0.1, mu_U = -ln 0.9, flat prior s in [0,10]); posterior predictive 0.84/0.11/0.05; equal-exposure updates 0.028/0.217/0.797 (used as checks)
June/Dec ratios 2.4 (delta = 300) and 28 (350); inelastic onset energies; 13% of rate above 270 keV at delta = 300
efficiency parametrisation (Fig. S2), modulation fractions 41/90/100%, day-grid method; stored seasonal tables used for a shape comparison
Higgsino delta(N=1) = 366 keV at 1 TeV; 4-5.2 events per 1000 live days; June/Dec = 46
background hypotheses at the 1e-3 - 1e-2 level (wall MSSI, ER leakage), cited as context

recalled_knowledge.item: Poisson rate with Gamma(alpha, rate beta) prior gives a negative-binomial predictive NB(alpha, p = beta/(beta + k))
Jeffreys prior for a Poisson mean is s^(-1/2), giving a Gamma(1.5, 1) posterior after one count
Gregorian calendar: 2024 is a leap year; 27 Mar 2023 - 1 Apr 2024 = 371 days; 1 Apr 2024 - 2 Sep 2026 = 884 days

failed_or_abandoned: First seasonal-PDF figure normalised the time density per year instead of per window (flat reference misplaced); corrected in the second run. Toy LR results unaffected.
delta = 380 keV June/December ratio is numerically ~1e5 because the December in-ROI rate is zero; reported as 'December rate = 0' instead of a ratio.

P006's stored rate_vs_doy tables at delta = 350/380 keV are flatter than our WimPyDD recomputation (which is energy-grid independent); attributed, without certainty, to P006 having run before lz.wd_halo received the explicit v_min grid. Not pursued further.
No 2D (S1c, log S2c) likelihood and no L10-specific time PDF (P006 found LR ~ 0.98 for dipole-like elastic spectra); the elastic best fit is treated as time-flat.
wimpydd_generated_files: none (WD.diff_rate via lz.wd_rate; no response-function files written)
